summary: Yakima County, WA ridge lookout: 1946 log cabin, 1954 L-4 cab, 40-ft DNR tower from 1968; last staffed 1998; storm-damaged and toppled by the DNR in 2007.

facts.design: 40-foot wooden tower with a 14 x 14 foot DNR live-in cab, after a 1946 log cabin and a 1954 L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Toppled and removed by the DNR in April 2007 (Willhite Web); no source describes what remains of the lookout on the summit
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service with Washington DNR (National Historic Lookout Register); Washington Dept of Natural Resources/Wenatchee National Forest (firelookout.com)

access.note: Willhite Web gives high-clearance 4WD routes to the summit and an alternate if the Benton Creek road is closed; no source states a public access rule

visit.trail_note: Willhite Web says both routes require high clearance 4WD; if the roads are no longer open, it suggests the Rock Creek Road to the ridge

events.note: First structure on the site was a log cabin, set up by the Division of Forestry after the war

National Historic Lookout Register says the lookout was destroyed in 2007

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register, the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register and firelookout.com give 1968; Willhite Web says late 1968 or 1969. The story reports both.

The Register gives 5,088 ft (1,551 m) at 46.823600, -120.856500. The Former Fire Lookout Sites Register gives 5,115 ft (1,559 m) at 46.820058, -120.849271. firelookout.com and Willhite Web also use 5,115 ft. The story reports the Register's figures and the other listing's figures without choosing.
The Former Fire Lookout Sites Register and firelookout.com say one leg broke; Willhite Web says two were severely damaged. The story reports both.

The Register lists U.S. Forest Service with Washington DNR; the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register lists only the U.S. Forest Service; firelookout.com lists Washington DNR with the Wenatchee National Forest.

notes_for_editor: Core dates agree across four sources: 1946 cabin, 1954 cab, 1968 or late-1968/1969 tower, last staffed 1998, toppled 2007. Coordinates and elevations differ, and the tower-leg damage differs. The 'today' paragraph says no source found; the Willhite photo caption 'Towers on the summit' is undated and does not say the lookout remains. The washingtonlookouts.weebly.com page was not used for citations, and no WebSearch was used.
